surface: Complete @dnd-kit/core 6.3.1 surface: DndContext, DragOverlay with drop animations, useDraggable/useDroppable/useDndContext/useDndMonitor, pointer/mouse/touch/keyboard sensors, collision detection, modifiers, measuring and auto-scroll configuration, and screen-reader announcements.
divergences: Sensor activator handlers receive the native DOM event; React passes a SyntheticEvent, and the built-in sensors read the event directly instead of `event.nativeEvent`. A custom sensor that destructures `{ nativeEvent }` must read the event itself.
ssr: Accessibility markup mounts after the first client effect, as upstream; no dedicated SSR lane.
notes: Ports the legacy dnd kit API (the @dnd-kit/core 6.x family) that `@octanejs/dnd-kit` does not cover; that package ports the modern `@dnd-kit/react` API.

Upstream ships placeholder unit tests (plus two modifier cases), so a repo-authored React differential carries the behavioral contract; the pinned suite also runs pristine and adapted. The npm releases record no `gitHead`, so the source is pinned to the `@dnd-kit/core@6.3.1` release-tag commit, which holds every package byte-identical to its own release tag; parity stays recorded-unverified.
